marks.gloss_en: בבא לידי כהן ומכרו לישראל במומו -- okimta (= p_oshaya_ba_lidei_kohen)
Rav Oshaya: [the mishna speaks] where it came into the hand of a priest and he sold it to an Israelite in its blemish
Rava: the claim [for the gifts] is with the butcher
כשהוא אומר מאת זובחי הזבח -- הוי אומר אפילו טבח כהן במשמע
Rava: 'from the people' -- not from the priests; when it says 'from those who slaughter the slaughter' -- even a priest-butcher is included
מאי טעמא עביד מר הכי? -- דכי אתא רבי אחא בר חנינא... זקני דרום אמרו
asked by R' Tavla מאי טעמא, RN gives his reason: the elders of the south -- a priest-butcher is obligated after two or three weeks (= p_zikenei_darom_kohen_tabach)
the elders of the south: a priest-butcher is exempt from the gifts two or three weeks; from then on he is obligated
כי הא דרבא קניס אטמא
רב נחמן בר יצחק קניס גלימא
reading 2: rather, that we fine them without a warning
מאי טעמא? אמר קרא למשחה -- לגדולה, כדרך שהמלכים אוכלים
Rav Chisda: the priestly gifts are eaten only roasted, and only with mustard
שנאמר המקריב את דם השלמים ואת החלב מבני אהרן

ולאו מילתא היא, דתניא: רבי שמעון אומר כל כהן שאינו מודה בעבודה אין לו חלק בכהונה -- the reason is that he does not acknowledge it; if he acknowledges it, even though not expert, [he receives] (133a.2)
Rav Chisda: [there are] twenty-four priestly gifts; any priest who is not expert in them -- one does not give him a gift
והא רבי טבלא פטרן! -- but R' Tavla exempted us (RN's reply here is only a threat: go give, or I will remove R' Tavla from your ear)
Rav Nachman obligated him [in the gifts]: go give them out
ולעביד ליה מר מיהת כרבי אחא בר חנינא! -- by your own source he should be exempt the first weeks
הני מילי דלא קבע מסחתא, אבל הכא הא קבע מסחתא (= p_rn_delo_kava_mesachta)
Rav Nachman: that [exemption] is where he did not establish a butcher shop; but here he did establish one
איני? והא כי אתא רב יצחק בר יוסף אמר: במערבא פלגינן להו גרמא גרמא -- the West divides each bone
Rav Chisda: the foreleg to one [priest], the maw to one, the jaw to two
התם בדתורא -- there, of an ox
ולית הלכתא כוותיה -- the halakha is not as R' Yochanan
R' Yochanan: it is forbidden to eat from an animal whose gifts were not lifted
והא תניא: ... במצות עשה... מכין אותו עד שתצא נפשו -- for a positive mitzva there is no limit, so the ban cannot lapse
reading 1 of Rabba bar Rav Shila's statement: that we no longer ban them
R' Tavla to his priest host: go partner with the Israelite butchers -- since they are exempted from the gifts, they will partner with you
Rav Chisda: a priest who does not separate the gifts -- let him be under the ban of the God of Israel

the baraita continues: I have only this [rite]; from where to include fifteen services -- the pourings, mixings, crumblings, saltings, wavings, bringings, handfuls, burnings, pinchings, receivings, sprinklings, giving the sota to drink, breaking the heifer's neck, the leper's purification and lifting the hands, inside or outside? the verse says 'of the sons of Aaron' -- any service stated of the sons of Aaron; and any priest who does not acknowledge it has no share in the priesthood
